targets.title: Dispositional greed.
targets.evidence_quote: The primary claim extracted for replication was as follows: controlling for MVS scores, scores on the DGS positively correlated with food behavioral inclinations (partial correlation: r = 0.21, p < .001).
targets.outcome_quote: Controlling for scores on the MVS, scores on the DGS were positively correlated with food behavioral inclinations, r(507) = .333, p < .001 (t = 7.94). Thus, we successfully replicated the claim.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Explicit successful primary-claim replication verdict; additional original Study 2 comparisons also agree.
